explication: Greenmask is a PostgreSQL logical-backup and data-anonymization utility. Its main workflow is to select database objects, optionally subset related rows, apply configured transformations while dumping, store the resulting backup, and later restore it. The CLI also exposes validation and dump/transformer management. The README documents additional transformation features and storage options; sampled source confirms runtime-context construction and row transformation, but not every command’s internal wiring, so uncertain links are omitted.
